description: Use this to know where Winquill looks: the countries and sources it reads, how many open, upcoming and awarded notices each holds, and when each was last read. Use it before telling the user a tender isn't published anywhere Winquill reads, or to say how fresh results are. Not for searching (use search_tenders). Example: {"country":"Canada"}

country.description: One country, e.g. "Canada", "UK" or "Germany". Omit for every country Winquill covers. Winquill reads Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, Public Contracts Scotland, Sell2Wales, CanadaBuys, SEAO, Toronto Bids, SAM.gov, USAC E-Rate, City Record Online, RAMP LA, SF City Partner, DC PASS, oeffentlichevergabe.de, BOAMP, TED, PLACSP, IUB (Latvia) and KIMDIS (Greece).

name: get_coverage
title: Show Winquill's coverage
